Updated only docs.yml and deploy-docs.yml.

  • Reusable build/publish path validates immutable source, checks current docs/examples before publishing, includes rustdoc in every version, and deploys the complete mike tree through Pages.
  • Refresh requires an existing stable tag, published GitHub release and exact source SHA. Copy aliases avoid artifact symlinks; initial dev and released latest root behavior preserved.
  • Reviewed source/diff only; no builds, tests, linters, commits, pushes or remote changes. Packaging owns updated dependencies, caller permissions and release-permission assertions; hosted Pages remains unverified.

items.html:
• P2 — Queued release publishing can be canceled. docs.yml:17 shares docs-deploy across development, release and refresh calls. cancel-in-progress: false protects running calls but permits newer calls to cancel an existing pending release call, stopping production publishing after TestPyPI upload. Add queue: max; GitHub now supports retaining pending deployments. GitHub concurrency documentation.

  • P2 — Published Markdown still escapes its documentation version. site.py:129 publishes Markdown before the HTML-only /latest/ rewrite. Consequently, versioned sources linked through llms.txt, including reference/rust.md:8, lead readers to latest rustdoc rather than that version’s rustdoc. Rewrite those Markdown link destinations when exporting the sources.
